semantics.summary: Sets the foreground and optional background colours for screen output subsequently produced by PRINT; the command is described as otherwise behaving like COLOR.
side-effects: Changes colour state used by PRINT screen output.

printed-pages: Chapter 13, printed p. 13-34 (same feature: combined update scan p. 14-4)
notes: The source documents PCOLOR foreground,background and examples with the background omitted.
The colour value range and exact interaction with all screen/window modes are not specified in this addendum passage.
